paper.title: Benchmarking of variant calling software for whole-exome sequencing using gold standard datasets.

sources.text: Following alignment of sequence reads to the human reference genome GRCh38, variants were compared against high-confidence regions from GIAB datasets and assessed using the Variant Calling Assessment Tool (VCAT).
Samples were aligned to human reference genome version GRCh38 and variant calling were done in single sample mode on default settings.
